name: ocloud
description: Create and orchestrate Olef Cloud agents, workspaces, scheduled tasks, event workflows, conversational threads, and your Olef inbox directly from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Create and orchestrate Olef Cloud agents, workflows, and threads
interface.longDescription: Teaches Codex the ocloud CLI so you can create cloud agents with smart workspace and runtime defaults, chat with them in multi-turn threads, schedule one-shot or recurring tasks, wire prompt-driven event subscriptions, install native skills, check out agents locally in --edit or --live mode, and watch your Olef inbox.
defaultPrompt: Create a cloud agent for me
In 1 minute, send me Hello world via my cloud agent
Ask my cloud agent what the capital of France is
